verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several public APIs under its developer docs: an HTTP/Warehouse Sync API with SQL reference and data mapping, a Platform API for Audiences, direct event ingestion, a real-time personalization API, and IDSync. Together these cover programmatic data ingestion, audience management and identity operations. Missing for 10: most evidence is page titles rather than API-reference detail (auth, endpoint coverage of configuration such as connections and outputs, which are shown as UI-driven), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via API.
